notes: Grey SFP (copper), electrical 1x RJ45. Typical reach 100m (footnote 1: using CAT5e cable or better). Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C (-TR) and -40°C to +85°C (-TR-I); two orderable variants. Power consumption < 1.2W. Transmission media: copper/LAN cable (1000 Mbps Ethernet). Technology: Sync on line side; preferred master (footnote 2: master mode uses local clock to transmit to other side). Auto-negotiation: No. Rx LOS: Yes. Storage temperature row in TECHNICAL DATA table has no values. Safety/regulatory: TUV/UL/FDA (contact Smartoptics for latest certification information), RoHS compliance.
suggestions: Add SFP to form_factor enum. Consider list or per-model fields for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when multiple SKUs share one datasheet. reach_km stores 0.1 from explicit 100m; document unit handling. connector_type enum is optical-focused; RJ45 is explicit for this product.
